cues.en: Instructor: Now that you know the formulas for computing the three main measures of central tendency, so mean, median, and mode,
cues.zh: 既然知道計算平均、中位數與眾數，三個主要集中趨勢量的公式，

cues.en: it's time to see these computations in action.
cues.zh: 就來看看實際計算。

cues.en: So let's start how we always start by creating some distributions of data.
cues.zh: 照慣例，先建立一些資料分布。

cues.en: We're gonna create some data sets.
cues.zh: 建立幾個資料集。

cues.en: So these are all, in this case, these are all going to be normally distributed random numbers and by now, after the last code video, you are super familiar with
cues.zh: 這次全是常態分布隨機數。上一部程式影片之後，你已非常熟悉，

cues.en: generating normally distributed random numbers.
cues.zh: 如何產生常態隨機數。

cues.en: And you can see I'm just changing the variance here, which actually isn't relevant for this particular video, but just to make things a little more interesting.
cues.zh: 這裡只是改變變異數，對這部影片其實無關，只是讓事情有趣一點。

cues.en: And here I'm shifting them by minus one, shifting by zero, and shifting by plus one.
cues.zh: 這裡向−1平移、向0平移、向+1平移。

cues.en: And then here I'm going to create their distributions, this code you've seen before already and then we plot them.
cues.zh: 接著建立分布，這段之前已看過，再畫圖。

cues.en: So let's see what these guys look like.
cues.zh: 看看樣子。

cues.en: Alright, so here we have our three empirical normal distributions.
cues.zh: 這是三個經驗常態分布。

cues.en: You can see they all look kind of Gaussian-ish.
cues.zh: 都大致像高斯。

cues.en: And this is the histogram and again, I'm using lines instead of bars because that facilitates looking at all three of these distributions at the same time.
cues.zh: 這是直方圖，又用線條代替長條，方便在同一張圖看三個分布。

cues.en: And here we have data counts and you of course now know how to convert this into proportion or probability if that's what you would like to do.
cues.zh: 這裡是次數，當然，你已知道需要時如何轉成比例或機率。

cues.en: Okay, so here we are going to create the mean of each of these distributions.
cues.zh: 現在計算各分布的平均。

cues.en: So, the mean of dataset one, dataset two, and dataset three.
cues.zh: 資料集一、二、三的平均。

cues.en: Here I'm explicitly writing out the formula for the mean.
cues.zh: 這裡明確寫出平均公式。

cues.en: So the sum of all the values divided by the number of values, but of course, in practice, it's better just to use the mean function like this.
cues.zh: 所有值加總，再除以數量。但實務上，直接用mean函式比較好。

cues.en: Okay and then all I'm doing is plotting them on top of this, on top of these distributions.
cues.zh: 接著只是把它們疊畫在這些分布上。

cues.en: So nothing super earth shatteringly amazing here.
cues.zh: 沒有什麼驚天動地的。

cues.en: Although I would like to point out quickly that in a kind of pure analytic Gaussian distribution, the mean corresponds to the peak of the distribution.
cues.zh: 但想快速指出，純粹的解析高斯分布中，平均對應峰。

cues.en: But in these empirical distributions, when you're creating them either by sampling random numbers or by sampling random data, it's not necessarily the case
cues.zh: 這些經驗分布，透過抽取隨機數，或抽取隨機資料建立，不一定，

cues.en: that the mean corresponds to the peak.
cues.zh: 平均就對應峰。

cues.en: In fact, it happened to be here in all three of these cases that the peak of the distribution, the largest value, was shifted to the right.
cues.zh: 剛好三個例子裡，分布峰、最大值，都往右移。

cues.en: But that was actually just chance.
cues.zh: 但只是巧合。

cues.en: That's probably not the same on your computer when you run this code.
cues.zh: 你在電腦上執行，大概不會一樣。

cues.en: So this is the true mean, well, the true empirical mean of this sample.
cues.zh: 這是真正的平均，或者說，這個樣本真正的經驗平均。

cues.en: But just for you to notice that the mean is not necessarily going to coincide with the peak of the distribution for empirical distributions.
cues.zh: 只是讓你注意，經驗分布的平均，不一定和峰重合。

cues.en: Okay, so now I would like to illustrate one of these failure scenarios of the meme.
cues.zh: 接著示範平均的其中一種失敗情況。

cues.en: Again, I put failure in apology quotes because it's not that the mean computation itself is failing,
cues.zh: 又把失敗加引號，因為不是平均計算本身失敗，

cues.en: it's that the mean fails to be a accurate, valid measure of the central tendency of these distributions.
cues.zh: 而是平均無法準確、有效描述這些分布的集中趨勢。

cues.en: So here I'm creating a distribution that has two modes in it, or two peaks in the distribution.
cues.zh: 這裡建立有兩個mode、兩個峰的分布。

cues.en: And I'm doing that basically just by concatenating random, normally distributed random numbers, one that's shifted to the left and one that's shifted to the right.
cues.zh: 基本上串接常態隨機數，一組向左平移，一組向右。

cues.en: Okay, so then we get the histogram and the mean, and that all gets plotted over here.
cues.zh: 接著取直方圖與平均，畫在這裡。

cues.en: So here you see the distribution of data, and this is the mean.
cues.zh: 這是資料分布，這是平均。

cues.en: It does not correspond to either of the two peaks, which is kind of the thing that you're interested in when you're studying central tendencies.
cues.zh: 不對應任何一個峰，而峰才是研究集中趨勢時關心的位置。

cues.en: So again, this isn't the incorrect value, it's just a little bit weird to interpret because it's not the case that most values are taking on the value close to the mean.
cues.zh: 同樣，這不是錯值，只是解讀有點奇怪，因為大多數值並沒有接近平均。

cues.en: Okay, so that was for mean.
cues.zh: 這就是平均。

cues.en: Now let's switch to median.
cues.zh: 換成中位數。

cues.en: And to illustrate the median, I'm going to generate a log normal distribution, which you've now seen several times before and a log normal distribution is interesting
cues.zh: 為了展示中位數，產生對數常態分布，之前看過幾次。它很適合，

cues.en: for illustrating the median because that is going to be different from the mean.
cues.zh: 展示中位數，因為會和平均不同。

cues.en: So here you see what the data look like, so all the gray dots are the data.
cues.zh: 這是資料，灰點都是資料點。

cues.en: The blue dash line corresponds to the median, the red dash line corresponds to the mean.
cues.zh: 藍色虛線對應中位數，紅色虛線對應平均。

cues.en: And here you see those two values on this histogram distribution here.
cues.zh: 這裡是兩個值在直方圖分布上的位置。

cues.en: Now in this case, it actually doesn't look so bad because the mean is only a little bit above the median, but you can see that there is this shift,
cues.zh: 這次其實沒那麼糟，平均只比中位數高一點，但能看到偏移，

cues.en: there's kind of a bias in the measure of central tendency because of these large low frequency values all the way out here.
cues.zh: 這裡遠處的大數值、低頻值，讓集中趨勢量有點偏差。

cues.en: Alright, so that is the median.
cues.zh: 這就是中位數。

cues.en: And now I wanna talk about the mode.
cues.zh: 現在談眾數。

cues.en: So what I'm gonna do to create the, or to illustrate the mode is create a data set of integers.
cues.zh: 要建立、示範眾數，先建立整數資料集。

cues.en: So I just generate 10 normally distributed random numbers and then round them.
cues.zh: 產生十個常態隨機數，再四捨五入。

cues.en: Now you can think of these as being discreet, numeric data.
cues.zh: 可以把它們想成離散數值資料。

cues.en: You can think of these as being nominal or ordinal data.
cues.zh: 也能想成名目或次序資料。

cues.en: It doesn't really matter.
cues.zh: 不重要。

cues.en: The point is that we have several discreet values in this data set.
cues.zh: 重點是資料集有幾個離散值。

cues.en: So then what I'm doing here is, so actually here is computing the mode down here.
cues.zh: 這裡，其實下面才是計算眾數。

cues.en: This is just a little bit of extra code just to drive the point home.
cues.zh: 這只是額外程式，讓重點更清楚。

cues.en: So first what I do is find all the unique values in this dataset, which are these five values.
cues.zh: 先找出所有唯一值，就是這五個。

cues.en: So obviously there's gonna be some repetitions here.
cues.zh: 顯然會有一些重複。

cues.en: And then here in this for loop, I'm just printing out the number of times that each of these unique values appears in this data set.
cues.zh: 接著在for迴圈中，列印每個唯一值在資料集出現幾次。

cues.en: So let's see what that happens to be.
cues.zh: 看看結果。

cues.en: Alright, so this tells us that, for example, minus two appears once in this dataset.
cues.zh: 例如，−2出現一次。

cues.en: And you can just see by looking at this, that this is going to be the mode, this is the value that appears most frequently in the dataset.
cues.zh: 只看就能知道，這會是眾數，也就是出現最頻繁的值。

cues.en: And in fact, that's what I'm going to display here, which is using the MATLAB function mode.
cues.zh: 這裡要顯示的，就是用MATLAB的mode函式。

cues.en: So this says the modal value is zero, zero appears the most number of times.
cues.zh: 它說眾數是0，0出現最多次。

cues.en: All right, so we are going to use code here to explore the measures of central tendency in different distributions.
cues.zh: 接著用程式，探索不同分布的集中趨勢量。

cues.en: So we start by creating some data distributions.
cues.zh: 先建立資料分布。

cues.en: In this case, I'm generating normally distributed, so Gaussian distributed random numbers.
cues.zh: 這次產生常態，也就是高斯隨機數。

cues.en: And by now you're super familiar with how this works, how to create normally distributed random numbers.
cues.zh: 現在已經非常熟悉如何產生。

cues.en: And what I'm doing here is creating one dataset.
cues.zh: 這裡建立一個資料集。

cues.en: So dataset D1, that's shifted a bit to the left.
cues.zh: D1稍微向左平移。

cues.en: This one is centered around zero, but it's gonna be a bit fatter, it's gonna be a wider distribution.
cues.zh: 這個以0為中心，但比較胖、比較寬。

cues.en: And this one, D3 is gonna be shifted to the right.
cues.zh: D3則向右平移。

cues.en: So here I create their histograms in terms of the bins and the heights, so that's going to let us visualize these
cues.zh: 這裡建立直方圖的區間與高度，讓我們能將它們，

cues.en: as line plots here and what's going on.
cues.zh: 畫成折線。怎麼了？

cues.en: Okay, NumPy not defined.
cues.zh: NumPy沒有定義。

cues.en: I have to run with this code.
cues.zh: 得先執行這段程式碼。

cues.en: So here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: Here you see all three distributions on a plot.
cues.zh: 同張圖看到三個分布。

cues.en: Again, these are come, these line plots come from histograms, but I'm not plotting them as bars because that's going to make it more difficult to interpret all three of these on the same graph.
cues.zh: 線圖來自直方圖，但不畫長條，因為會更難在同圖解讀三者。

cues.en: But you can see they look more or less like a Gaussian.
cues.zh: 可以看到，都大致像高斯。

cues.en: The empirical distributions will basically never look like true pure Gaussians.
cues.zh: 經驗分布基本上永遠不會像真正純粹的高斯。

cues.en: Okay and you can also see the Y axis is showing data counts.
cues.zh: y軸顯示次數。

cues.en: And of course, if you like, you know how to convert this into proportion or probability.
cues.zh: 當然，願意的話，已知道如何轉比例或機率。

cues.en: Okay, so what we're gonna do now is overlay the mean on top of these different distributions.
cues.zh: 現在把平均，疊畫在各個分布上。

cues.en: And I'm doing that by, well, here I'm explicitly writing out the function for the or the formula for the mean.
cues.zh: 這裡明確寫出平均函式，或者說公式。

cues.en: So we sum up all the data values and divide by the number of data values.
cues.zh: 加總資料值，再除以數量。

cues.en: But of course, in practice it's not really handy to write it out like this.
cues.zh: 但實際上，這樣寫不方便。

cues.en: It's a little bit easier to just call the NumPy function mean, which will give the same result as this one.
cues.zh: 直接呼叫NumPy的mean函式更容易，結果相同。

cues.en: Okay, so here you see the distributions and the means plotted on top.
cues.zh: 這是分布，上面畫出平均。

cues.en: Now, one thing I would like to point out here is that when you have an analytic Gaussian distribution, the mean value is exactly the same thing as the peak
cues.zh: 想指出，解析高斯分布的平均值，恰好等於，

cues.en: of the distribution.
cues.zh: 分布峰所在的值。

cues.en: Because a true Gaussian distribution is perfectly symmetric.
cues.zh: 因為真正高斯分布完全對稱。

cues.en: So the peak and the mean are the same value.
cues.zh: 所以峰與平均是同一個值。

cues.en: However, in empirical distributions, that's rarely going to be the case.
cues.zh: 但經驗分布中，很少如此。

cues.en: So you will often find that the peak of the distribution is not the same as the average of the distribution.
cues.zh: 經常會看到，峰與平均值不同。

cues.en: They should be close if it's a Gaussian distribution, they should be close, but they're not gonna be the same.
cues.zh: 如果是高斯，兩者應接近，但不會相同。

cues.en: You can see that example here where the peak of this red distribution is actually shifted a bit to the right, looks like for this black distribution, it's shifted a tiny bit to the left.
cues.zh: 這裡紅色分布的峰稍向右移，黑色分布則似乎稍向左。

cues.en: Of course, that's gonna look different in your computer, in your graph because of the random sampling.
cues.zh: 因為隨機抽樣，你的電腦、圖上會不同。

cues.en: Okay, so that's for the mean.
cues.zh: 這是平均。

cues.en: What I wanna show you here is a failure case of the mean.
cues.zh: 這裡展示平均的失敗情況。

cues.en: And again, as I did in the previous video, I'm putting failure in apology quotes here because it's not that the formula for the mean is failing,
cues.zh: 和前一部一樣，失敗加引號，因為不是公式失敗，

cues.en: it's that the mean here fails to be really representative of the central tendency of the data.
cues.zh: 而是這個平均，無法真正代表資料的集中趨勢。

cues.en: So what I'm doing to create this dataset is stacking together or concatenating two normal distributions or two data sampled from normal distribution.
cues.zh: 建立方法，是堆疊、串接兩個常態分布，或從常態分布抽出的兩組資料。

cues.en: One is shifted a bit to the left and one is shifted a bit to the right.
cues.zh: 一個稍向左，一個稍向右。

cues.en: So let's see what that looks like.
cues.zh: 看看結果。

cues.en: And then we'll also see, well here's what the histogram looks like and here's the mean.
cues.zh: 這是直方圖，這是平均。

cues.en: So again, the failure here is that the mean value does not correspond to the centroids of the data sets
cues.zh: 失敗在於，平均不對應資料集的中心，

cues.en: where you expect the most amount of data to be clustered.
cues.zh: 也就是預期最多資料聚集的位置。

cues.en: So you expect most data to be clustered here and here, and not that much data to be clustered here.
cues.zh: 預期多數資料在這裡與這裡，這裡則不多。

cues.en: However, this is where the mean value ends up being.
cues.zh: 平均卻在這裡。

cues.en: So, in this case, we have a non Gaussian distribution, a non-normal distribution, and the mean is not really representative
cues.zh: 這是非高斯、非常態分布，平均無法真正代表，

cues.en: of the main characteristics of the distributions.
cues.zh: 主要的分布特徵。

cues.en: Okay, enough about the mean, let's switch to median.
cues.zh: 平均說夠了，換中位數。

cues.en: Well, actually we're still gonna be talking about the mean here.
cues.zh: 不過，其實這裡還是會談平均。

cues.en: What I'm going to do is illustrate the difference between the mean and the median in a log normal distribution.
cues.zh: 要在對數常態分布中，展示平均與中位數的差別。

cues.en: And the log normal distribution is convenient to use for this purpose because it's skewed to the right, it has a heavy tail to the right.
cues.zh: 它很方便，因為向右偏斜，右邊有厚尾。

cues.en: So let's see.
cues.zh: 看看。

cues.en: Here, we see all the individual data points in gray, and then we have the median in horizontal blue line, and the mean in the red line.
cues.zh: 灰色是所有個別資料點，藍色水平線是中位數，紅線是平均。

cues.en: And here in this histogram, you can also see the mean and the median.
cues.zh: 直方圖中，也能看到平均與中位數。

cues.en: So in fact, it turns out that in this case, the mean and the median are relatively close to each other.
cues.zh: 事實上，在這個例子中，平均數與中位數相當接近。

cues.en: So there aren't too many really, really large values that are pulling the mean up too strongly.
cues.zh: 沒有太多非常大的值，把平均強烈往上拉。

cues.en: Nonetheless, in this case, the median is a more representative measure of the central tendency, the primary clustering of the values in the data compared to the mean,
cues.zh: 不過，中位數更能代表集中趨勢，也就是資料主要聚集的位置，相較平均，

cues.en: which is a bit biased because of these outliers.
cues.zh: 平均因為離群值而略有偏差。

cues.en: Alright, and then finally, I want to illustrate the mode.
cues.zh: 最後展示眾數。

cues.en: So what I'm doing here is showing the, or creating data from random numbers, normally distributed random numbers and then rounding them.
cues.zh: 建立常態隨機數資料，再四捨五入。

cues.en: So let me show you what these data look like before we get to any of this stuff.
cues.zh: 先看資料長什麼樣，再看其他內容。

cues.en: So in fact, I'll comment out all of these lines.
cues.zh: 把這些行全部註解掉。

cues.en: So this is what our dataset looks like.
cues.zh: 這是資料集樣子。

cues.en: It's all integers.
cues.zh: 全是整數。

cues.en: You can think of these as discreet numeric data.
cues.zh: 可以當作離散數值資料。

cues.en: You can think of them as nominal or ordinal data.
cues.zh: 也能當作名目或次序資料。

cues.en: It doesn't really matter.
cues.zh: 不重要。

cues.en: The point is that we have a relatively small collection of values that our data can take.
cues.zh: 重點是資料能取的值，相對少。

cues.en: So, and then what I'm doing here is creating all of the, or determining all of the unique values in this dataset.

cues.en: And it looks like only one instance of the number one.
cues.zh: 看起來只有一個1。

cues.en: Now, of course, that's gonna be different here because I'm generating new random numbers.
cues.zh: 當然，重新產生隨機數，所以這裡會不同。

cues.en: So actually this is a pretty interesting case here.
cues.zh: 這其實是個有趣情況。

cues.en: We see that this distribution has two modes.
cues.zh: 分布有兩個眾數。

cues.zh: 這裡有兩個眾數，−1與0。

cues.zh: 可以忽略這個負號。

cues.zh: 所以0是眾數。現在列印「眾數值為」，再使用stats模組，

cues.zh: 這個特定資料集的眾數是−1，因為−1出現最頻繁。
